climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Pinot Gris, Gewürztraminer, Riesling, Pinot Noir and Chardonnay fully without cooking off their freshness.

soil.rock: Sandstone is sand bound into rock. It weathers to light, sandy soil that drains freely.
soil.top: The topsoil drains well and still stores water for dry spells, so vines grow evenly. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.
